results.title: Volkswagen loss hits €5.8bn as Porsche, China and tariffs bite - The Next Web
results.snippet: Volkswagen lost €5.8bn after tax in the third quarter. Shrinking sales in China, US import tariffs and thinner margins on electric cars added to it. In the same quarter last year, the loss was €1.1bn. The group published the figures on Thursday in its nine-month results. It was Volkswagen’s largest quarterly loss since the end of 2015, a company spokesperson told Reuters. Revenue fell 6.3% to €75.
